text: Dale and Jade went into a maze to win a game.
The maze was long and full of snakes.
Dale said to Jade, "I can not go on."
"Yes, you can. You are brave!" said Jade.
Dale and Jade walk and walk.

tappable_word_questions.prompt: Tap the word that names the place that is long and full of snakes.
Tap the word that describes Dale when Jade cheers him on.
Tap the word that tells what Dale and Jade do after Dale feels stuck.

comprehension_question.prompt: Why does Dale say he cannot go on at first?
options: The maze is scary with snakes and feels too hard

text: At last, they made a left and got to the end of the maze.
Then they see six small caves.
"Let's go into the last cave," said Jade.
In the back of the cave, they see a gate!
The gate is shut. How will they pass?

tappable_word_questions.prompt: Tap how many small caves they see.
Tap the word for the openings in rock they explore.
Tap the word names the thing blocking their way.

text: Dale shakes the gate. Jade kicks the gate.
"Look! The gate has a lock," yells Jade.
The gate swings in. Dale and Jade win the game!

tappable_word_questions.prompt: Tap what Dale does first to move the barrier.
Tap the word Dale turns to open the latch.
Tap the sound word when the gate finally opens.

comprehension_question.prompt: How do Dale and Jade get past the gate at the end?
